Mainly because your brother is being very sloppy. He is using a Bit Torrent engine that not only seeds, but also acts as tracker library. The tracker are what is likely reporting the IP on the open internet. When a torrent downloaded, the initial download is a tracker which tells the bit torrent engine meta data about the file to be downloaded, and usually network locations of trackers. - These contain a list of IPs associated with the copied files, and tells the engine where the files are located. As he has been associated with more than 1 IP address (The Uni's and your home's at minimum), when the trackers are updated, it likely includes all the IPs associated with his computer. In other words, any network where he has ran the bit torrent engine.

This is one of the reasons to use a VPN, and possibly a proxy, and if he is doing this on a large scale, then a cloud based seed server.
